title: Stronger Sovereignty, Better AI: It Starts with Controlling Your Data
summary: Your AI Strategy Is Stuck Behind Your Application-Centric Architecture
body_markdown:
### Summary


Data primacy is the organizing principle, and data sovereignty and AI-ready data are what it produces. This post covers what’s new across the Unified Data Plane, Intelligent Control Plane, and universal data intelligence, and what each one delivers.


For the last two decades, the application was the center of gravity. It owned the data, decided where it lived, and controlled who got to use it. Entire categories of tooling—ETL, MDM, and BI—exist only to paper over the fragmentation this app-centric architecture left behind.


AI exposes the cost of that model. It requires a broad, real-time view of data across systems grounded in what is actually true across the business. That means the value has to come from the *data* apps generate and the context that connects it, rather than from any single app. Most enterprises aren’t set up that way yet. Control still sits with the apps, and until it moves to the data, AI will keep hitting the same walls.


*Figure 1: The old world of application-centric architecture is over; data is now the center of gravity.*


AI initiatives were impacted by that gap right away. Models, trained on data without the context that gives it meaning, return answers that come back incomplete or wrong. Getting past that means moving control from the apps to the data itself. **Data becomes the center of gravity—agents and infrastructure follow it** . We call this shift[data primacy](https://blog.everpuredata.com/perspectives/data-processing-to-data-primacy/) .


This is a massive transformation for organizations of any size, and there are different ways to get started. At Everpure, we’re helping you make that transition at the infrastructure level.


The[Enterprise Data Cloud](https://www.everpuredata.com/enterprise-data-cloud.html) (EDC) is our architectural and operating model for taking a first step toward data primacy. It redefines the data infrastructure layer and control plane to be centered around data. Our universal data intelligence layer discovers, classifies, and maps data across all Everpure and non-Everpure environments. Together, this allows you to *unify, govern, and understand* your data across your entire estate. The[Everpure Platform](https://www.everpuredata.com/platform.html) helps you build your own EDC.


*Figure 2: The Everpure Platform helps you build your Enterprise Data Cloud.*


## **Unified Data Plane: One foundation for every workload**


A data-centric world requires a unified data foundation to tackle the needs of all your workloads, from archive to AI. That’s only possible if the foundation flexes on performance, protocols, and workload placement without forcing another copy.


This release expands that foundation in three directions: improving efficiency from a capacity and performance perspective, simplifying AI deployments and virtualization efforts, and expanding enterprise file capabilities.


### **Next-generation capacity and performance**


**More capacity from the same footprint**


Classic deduplication only looks for identical blocks, so it misses reduction opportunities where data is only partially changed.[Purity DeepReduce](https://blog.everpuredata.com/products/announcing-purity-deepreduce/) ™ finds similarities inside the blocks, which also makes it effective at reducing pre-compressed data—where most other approaches fall short. This reduction is near-instantaneous and runs continuously across[FlashBlade](https://www.everpuredata.com/products/unstructured-data-storage.html) ® with no scheduling and no write-latency impact.


- Achieve a median 2:1 global data reduction on[FlashBlade//E](https://www.everpuredata.com/content/dam/pdf/en/datasheets/ds-pure-storage-flashblade-e.pdf) ™ and[FlashBlade//S](https://www.everpuredata.com/content/dam/pdf/en/datasheets/ds-pure-storage-flashblade-s.pdf) ™, on top of the compression FlashBlade already delivers.
- Find what dedupe misses with sub-block similarity matching, effective even on pre-compressed content.
- Run it continuously, always on, without batch jobs, maintenance windows, or write-latency impact.


**Evergreen//One gets better with age**


Every latency-sensitive ****[Evergreen//One](https://www.everpuredata.com/products/evergreen-staas.html) ™ service gets a significant boost to its minimum SLA with base performance improvements. UBF Performance, Premium, and Ultra all double, and existing customers get the new floor immediately, without waiting for a renewal.


- Double your minimum SLAs on every latency-sensitive tier, with UBF Performance going from 1GB/s to 2GB/s, Premium from 2GB/s to 4GB/s, and Ultra from 3GB/s to 6GB/s.
- Raise your performance floor without a renegotiation or a redeployment.


Workloads that reduce well will now be more cost-effective. The new efficiency allowance runs daily for every license and caps chargeable effective used capacity at 5X physical used capacity whenever reported reducibility exceeds 5X.[Pure1](https://www.everpuredata.com/products/monitoring-fleet-management.html) **®** shows the arithmetic behind the bill, with historical cap adjustment views and license-level drilldown.


- Leverage high data reduction without penalty.
- Reconcile array usage to license usage in Pure1, with virtual, reduction, effective used, efficiency allowance, net, reserve commit, and overage in one billing breakdown.


**More inference from every GPU**


Production inference is displacing training as the dominant AI workload, and cost per token depends on how much active inference each installed GPU can carry. Pure Key-Value Accelerator (KVA) enhancements use memory more efficiently through a three-tier architecture and add broader model and runtime support.


Containerized execution, NVIDIA Dynamo support, and enterprise multi-tenancy let teams share that infrastructure safely.


- Get up to 35X faster time to first token for RAG and conversational AI, based on internal Pure KVA performance testing.
- Carry more active inference per GPU with a three-tier memory architecture, lowering cost per token on GPUs you already own.
- Share infrastructure safely with containerized execution, enterprise multi-tenancy, and zero data set relocation.


**Sovereign AI in a cost-efficient way**


Enterprises want to own their data and control AI costs. Intelligent token optimization is a reference architecture for cost-effective hybrid inference on open source models, across on-prem and cloud resources, covering where a workload runs and how it reaches data. This means you reduce AI operating costs by running more inference on trusted open source models on on-prem infrastructure, while still using cloud AI services where and when it’s necessary.


- Place workloads intentionally and run inference where it makes economic and operational sense.
- Keep enterprise data close, with less movement and sensitive data on trusted infrastructure.
- Preserve cloud flexibility and use cloud AI services where they add value, not as the default.


### **Optimizing AI and modern virtualization workloads**


**VMs and containers in one cluster**


Modern virtualization now runs on the same unified data plane. Red Hat OpenShift Virtualization on **Microsoft** **Azure Red Hat OpenShift with** Everpure Cloud **** runs VMs and containerized workloads side by side without application refactoring, on either Everpure Cloud Dedicated or Azure Native. Reducing overprovisioning and optimizing storage lowers TCO as those workloads modernize.


- Decouple storage from compute to right-size compute independently and scale persistent storage as workload requirements change, reducing overprovisioning.
- Improve storage efficiency and cloud economics with thin provisioning, deduplication, and compression, targeting up to a 40% reduction in cloud storage costs.
- Choose either Everpure Cloud Azure Native or Everpure Cloud Dedicated based on your deployment needs.


**One cluster for AI and enterprise workloads**


[Portworx](https://www.everpuredata.com/products/kubernetes-data-management.html) ® flexible storage for AI workloads helps MLOps platforms align the right storage to the workloads they serve. GPU and AI workloads run on local NVMe alongside Portworx cloud drives, so local disks and cloud drives co-exist in the same node and the same cluster. Capacity adds and pool expansion are managed declaratively through Kube Datastore.


- Run GPU and AI workloads on local NVMe alongside cloud drives, without splitting node pools.
- Add capacity and expand pools declaratively through Kube Datastore, with no downtime and no data loss.
- Unblock VMware exits by using the same node for mixed backends.


**A lower-risk path from pilot to production**


Everpure AI Factory with Red Hat AI is a validated architecture for production AI workloads, built on Red Hat AI and NVIDIA. There are three separate reference architectures, covering training, hybrid inference across on-premises and cloud, and inference paired with Pure KVA. You get pre-tested frameworks and enterprise-ready deployment patterns instead of designing the stack yourself.


- Choose from three validated reference architectures: training (available now), hybrid inference (coming in October), and inference paired with Pure KVA (coming in October).
- Move from experimentation to production with less risk on trusted infrastructure and enterprise-ready deployment patterns.


### **Expanding enterprise file capabilities**


**Isolate, manage, and recover file data at scale**


File data now gets the isolation and recovery controls block and object needs at scale. FlashBlade realms provide file-system and object multi-tenancy, and File QoS ceilings control performance inside those realms. Protection and recovery run at scale whether the data sits on[FlashArray](https://www.everpuredata.com/products/block-file-object-storage.html) ™ or FlashBlade.


- Isolate tenants with FlashBlade realms for file-system and object multi-tenancy.
- Control performance with File QoS ceilings inside those realms.
- Protect and recover file data at scale, whether it sits on FlashArray or FlashBlade.


The FlashArray//XL190 is the top of the FlashArray line, built to consolidate the most demanding mission-critical workloads onto a single high-performance array so you can run more workloads without trading away resilience. Purity Turbo, available through a simple software upgrade, extends that headroom further. It unlocks a higher performance ceiling on the same array so it can, for example, sustain heavy data protection traffic alongside production without robbing either one.


- Consolidate mixed production and data protection workloads on one array without performance degradation.
- Absorb read bursts and backup spikes inside your existing SLA, so you keep headroom without oversizing infrastructure.


**The industry’s highest throughput for AI, validated once again**


[FlashBlade//EXA](https://www.pure.ai/flashblade-exa.html) ™ is now the highest-throughput system in the industry for AI,[earning the number one result for several MLPerf Storage v3.0 benchmark tests](https://blog.everpuredata.com/purely-technical/everpure-flashblade-exa-tops-mlperf-storage-v3-benchmarks/) . As the industry’s standardized benchmark for AI infrastructure performance, MLPerf Storage v3.0 validated the **exceptional** capabilities of Everpure™ FlashBlade//EXA. FlashBlade//EXA claimed the top spot across every category it entered:


- **#1** — Checkpointing, 405B-parameter full model (read and write)
- **#1** — Checkpointing, 1.25-trillion-parameter full model (read and write)
- **#1** — KV-cache, all metrics


GPUs are the most expensive thing in your AI budget, and the fastest way to waste that spend is to leave them idle waiting on data. FlashBlade//EXA keeps them all working, so the infrastructure you’ve already paid for stays utilized.


## **Intelligent Control Plane: Govern and automate at fleet scale**


A broader data foundation means that you need more control across the estate. Managing each array manually does not scale, and it does not move at the speed the business expects. The answer is the Enterprise Data Cloud (EDC) operating model that runs the whole estate as one fleet—a set of Everpure-managed arrays—where policies follow the data and automation does the heavy lifting.


The days of every volume having its own policy and every site its own baseline are coming to an end.


**Standardize configurations across the fleet**


Most estates carry hundreds of inconsistent per-volume configurations, set years apart by different people. Pure1 Configuration Advisor (beta) reduces them to a small governed set of policies, which removes the steady manual load of maintaining protection, performance, and QoS by hand. It recommends and changes nothing on its own, so you see the impact of a change before you approve it.


- Assess the estate by app, protection policy, performance, array, or location, and tune the clustering with sliders.
- Exclude what should not be touched, and see the impact before you approve.
- Codify the result through[Everpure Fusion](https://www.everpuredata.com/products/automation-orchestration.html) ™ or your own AI, or export it as an executive summary, JSON, or Markdown.


**Classification that reaches the volume**


Once data is classified, that context has to reach the infrastructure holding it. Pure1 workflows for Data Intelligence is a pre-built recipe in Pure1 Workflow Orchestrator that runs on a schedule. It discovers data sources, extracts sensitivity classifications through MCP, iterates hosts to find their attached volumes, assigns data classes to those volumes, and hands the policy to Everpure Fusion to execute.


- Enrich workflows with data context, discovered and classified continuously where it lives.
- Turn intelligence into action, with MCP exposing sensitivity context to control-plane workflows.
- Automate governance at fleet scale, without manual intervention.


**See what’s wrong in the cluster**


Portworx Observability gives Kubernetes and storage administrators a single pane of glass for cluster health, active alerts, events, and critical workloads. Topology drill-down and per-object insights cover volumes, storage nodes, and storage pools, and a metrics browser supports Prometheus queries. The first release is diagnostic, and the measure is mean time to resolve an issue.


- Get full visibility into cluster issues, with health, alerts, events, and impacted workloads in one place.
- Trace blast radius to root cause, drilling from cluster to volume, node, or pool with remediation tips inline.
- Make fixes without leaving the UI, using the built-in Prometheus browser.


## **Universal Data Intelligence: Understand all your data**


Storing and classifying data is necessary, but it is not enough for AI. The hardest problem is understanding the data: knowing what you have, what it means, and whether it can be trusted, wherever it lives. AI requires all of this to be *useful* .


**Shift from finding data to understanding it**


Raw data tells you what exists; semantics tells you what it means and how it relates to everything else.[Everpure Data Intelligence](https://www.everpuredata.com/products/data-intelligence.html) (formerly 1touch) adds contextual data intelligence to your data, grounding AI in a real enterprise context.


- Discover data continuously across all your environments so nothing stays invisible to the business. This includes sources beyond Everpure, from data stored on mainframes to SaaS applications.
- Classify that data with AI-driven semantics so sensitive, valuable, and AI-relevant data is understood in context rather than just inventoried.
- Trust what AI produces because it’s grounded in a semantic map of your enterprise data rather than guesswork.


Today, we’re announcing expanded Everpure Data Intelligence capabilities designed to further catalog and classify all your data wherever it may live.


**See your entire file estate**


Everpure Data Intelligence File Edition scans a file environment by metadata alone, with no content read. It reports freshness, file age, and concentration signals at the share and folder level, across CIFS/SMB, NFS, OneDrive and SharePoint, and Google Workspace. Infrastructure owners get tiering and reclaim signals from the same pass that shows security teams where exposure sits.


- See the whole file estate in one view, hybrid and multi-cloud.
- Surface stale and overexposed data with file-age and concentration signals at share and folder level.
- Reclaim capacity using tiering signals your team can act on, without a full content scan.


**Query the estate in plain language**


Native MCP server support implements the open Model Context Protocol, so AI, data, and CISO teams query the catalog in plain language instead of filing a request with the team that owns the tool. Agents query it the same way and get an asset’s sensitivity class alongside the finding. Neither route requires custom API work.


- Ask in plain language and get findings back, without waiting on the team that owns the tool.
- Feed agents directly, with sensitivity class as an input to AI, agent workflows, and analytics.
- Generate C-suite reports with the LLM your teams already use.


**Wider coverage across the estate with multi-cloud classification**


The classification engine now covers analytics estates and cloud-native transactional systems, including Microsoft Fabric, on top of the connectors Data Intelligence already supports. Tolly Group validated its out-of-the-box accuracy at 98.6%, so the new sources feed a pipeline that has been measured. Enhanced Microsoft Purview integration and webhooks connect the findings to the rest of your stack.


- Cover more of the estate as new sources come online, including sources beyond Everpure.
- Plug into your ecosystem with Purview integration and webhooks for custom automation.


**Streamlined from order to first insight**


Our first release required professional services and took time to install. Now the open virtual appliance (OVA) file and its configuration package download straight from Pure1. Deployment is roughly as involved as deploying a VM, which simplifies Data Intelligence installation.


- Simplify deployment by installing the OVA from Pure1 with just a few clicks.
- Discover, trial, quote, install, and track orders in the Pure1 catalog you already use.


*Figure 4: Everpure delivers for customers at any stage of their AI-ready data journey.*


## **Stronger cyber posture with a human in the loop**


Cyber resilience has two jobs: minimize the risk of disruption and minimize the impact when a breach happens. Attack breakout time is 65% faster than last year, so the second job now gets as much attention as the first.


Everpure Enterprise Advantage Services is a new three-tier professional services subscription designed for organizations that want the additional safety of a human-led operating motion for more secure and governed data.


- Essentials is the foundation tier and replaces the previous Service Account Manager (SAM)-only offering.
- Enhanced adds operational control with a single point of contact, a designated engineer, a 15-minute SLO on Sev1 cases, and monthly health checks.
- Elite is the cyber resilience partnership, with everything in Enhanced plus a critical response engineer and a cyber assessment.


*Figure 5: Everpure Enterprise Advantage Services tiers help you get the most out of your Everpure investment.*


Elite covers both prevention and dynamic response with a human in the loop the whole way. It’s how we help you turn the Enterprise Data Cloud vision into reality through structured engagement, not just technology.


## **One platform for all your data**


The shift from applications to data-centric architecture is already underway. The good news is that you already own your differentiating strategic advantage: your data. What you need is a way to unlock its value. That’s where data primacy comes in—data sovereignty and AI-ready data are what it produces.


Our 2026 Global Data Sovereignty Report found that 90% of enterprises call sovereignty core to their IT strategy, and 64% have not embedded a strategy for it. Closing that gap starts with knowing what data you have, where it sits, and who touches it.


AI depends on these same factors. Agents can only reason across systems when context is unified and there’s a shared semantic understanding of what data actually means.


Bringing these concepts together, the enterprises that thrive in this new world will be the ones whose data is **stored, governed, and understood** as a single system. That’s what the Enterprise Data Cloud delivers. That’s what Everpure is here to do.
